analysis.drc_harm: paired whole-board DRC ERROR delta CI lower bound > 0
analysis.wirelength_ceiling_support: if universal routability ceiling, common-valid paired wirelength delta CI upper bound < 0

board_sampling.easy_final_selection: first up to 10 structurally eligible easy boards in official d3.json order; require at least 3
board_sampling.easy_structural_source_frame: ALL official easy.test boards in configs/datasets/d3.json, screened without policy routing outcomes
board_sampling.hard_source_frame: original fixed 10 hard.test boards from v3; unchanged
board_sampling.medium_source_frame: original fixed 10 medium.test boards from v3; unchanged
board_sampling.source: PCBWorld v1.0.0 shipped D3 test split

endpoints.ceiling_fallback: whole-board wirelength on common-valid boards if natural and hard-first both have target routability 1.0 on every analyzed board
endpoints.safety: whole-board DRC ERROR count after target routing
secondary: whole-board via count on common-valid boards

forbidden: changing the fixed 30-board source list after routing outcomes
changing target eligibility after routing outcomes
changing the stable-hash cap after routing outcomes
post-hoc promotion of easy-first or any new policy
using Phase 8B to reopen Phase 7 model selection

policies.mst_easy_first: ascending terminal MST; net_id tie break; negative-control description only
policies.mst_hard_first: descending terminal MST; for two-pad nets terminal MST equals pad-to-pad Euclidean distance; net_id tie break

supersedes: Phase8B prereg v1 generated before any Phase8B routing outcome
Phase8B prereg v2 generated before any Phase8B routing outcome
Phase8B prereg v3 structural source-frame plan; stopped before routing outcomes
supersession_reason: The v3 preregistered 30-board structural screen produced 14 eligible boards and zero eligible easy boards, so the prespecified minimum-total and minimum-easy feasibility gate stopped before any policy routing. v4 preserves every target-net rule, policy, endpoint, threshold and statistical rule, and expands only the easy pre-outcome structural source frame to the complete official D3 easy.test list.

target_rule.candidate: exactly 2 pads, positive terminal Euclidean distance, both pad observations on the same routing layer
target_rule.cap_rule: stable SHA256(d3_id|net_id), independent of MST and all routing outcomes

within_net.action_failure_handling: issue the frozen four-action sequence for every requested net without action-success-based early stopping; record each action_success/action_class. Only Python/native exceptions are API errors.
within_net.pad_order: ascending pad key, exactly matching frozen Phase 8A runner semantics
